description: The strict-order structure \((\mathbb N,<)\) has an elementary embedding \(h\) into a countable strict linear order \(N\) with no greatest element and with a point \(b\) satisfying \(h(n)<b\) for every original natural number \(n\). This point lies outside the image of \(h\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.DiagramsAndExtensions.natural_order_countable_extension_upper_bound :
  ∃ N r,
    Countable N ∧ IsStrictTotalOrder N r ∧ (∀ (x : N), ∃ y, r x y) ∧ ∃ h b, (∀ (n : ℕ), r (h n) b) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), h n ≠ b
